tools.name: claritysoft_get_accounts
tools.description: List or find CRM accounts (companies). Pass account_id for one account. Resource Account, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_contacts
tools.description: List or find CRM contacts (people). Pass contact_id for one contact. Resource Contact, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_leads
tools.description: List or find CRM leads (prospects). Pass lead_id for one lead. Resource Lead, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_opportunities
tools.description: List or find sales opportunities (deals) with amount and close date. Resource Opportunity, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_quotations
tools.description: List or find quotations (price offers). Pass quotation_id for one quotation. Resource Quotation, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_sales_orders
tools.description: List or find sales orders. Pass sales_order_id for one order. Resource SalesOrder, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_invoices
tools.description: List or find invoices. Pass invoice_id for one invoice. Resource Invoice, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_products
tools.description: List or find products in the price list. Pass product_id for one product. Resource Product, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_get_activities
tools.description: List or find activities (tasks, calls, meetings) and their completion status. Resource Activity, Operation Get.

tools.name: claritysoft_create_account
tools.description: Create a CRM account (company). Writes a new record. Resource Account, Operation Create.

tools.name: claritysoft_update_account
tools.description: Change fields of one CRM account. Overwrites the given fields. Resource Account, Operation Edit.

tools.name: claritysoft_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity (deal) for an account. Writes a new record. Resource Opportunity, Operation Create.

tools.name: claritysoft_update_lead
tools.description: Change fields of one lead. Overwrites the given fields. Resource Lead, Operation Edit.

tools.name: claritysoft_update_activity
tools.description: Change fields of one activity, for example its Status. Resource Activity, Operation Edit.
